title: Typed Note Service
prompt: Define TypedDict NoteDict(id: int, text: str), a @runtime_checkable Protocol NoteStore with add(note_id: int, text: str) -> None and get(note_id: int) -> str | None, class MemoryNotes implementing both, and function save_note(store: NoteStore, note: NoteDict) -> bool that raises ValueError when note['text'] is empty/whitespace, otherwise stores and returns True.

tests.name: stores a valid note
tests.code:
m = MemoryNotes()
assert save_note(m, {'id': 1, 'text': 'buy milk'}) is True
assert m.get(1) == 'buy milk'

tests.name: rejects blank text
tests.code:
m = MemoryNotes()
try:
    save_note(m, {'id': 2, 'text': '   '})
    failed = False
except ValueError:
    failed = True
assert failed
tests.hint: Whitespace-only text must raise ValueError before touching the store.

tests.name: missing get returns None
tests.code:
m = MemoryNotes()
assert m.get(999) is None
tests.hint: get returns None for unknown ids.

tests.name: annotations verifiable
tests.code:
import typing
hints = typing.get_type_hints(NoteDict)
assert hints['id'] is int and hints['text'] is str
tests.hint: NoteDict fields must carry id: int and text: str.
